In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of designing precoding matrices for multiple-input multiple-output systems with space-time block codes and channel mean and transmit correlation knowledge at the transmitter.
the design of linear precoding for space-time coded systems with channel statistics at the transmitter.
the design of linear precoders for a MIMO wireless system with nonzero mean channel.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optimal linear precoders for the considered channel statistics and PEP design criteria have been obtained, with both analytical and numerical results provided.
the proposed precoder designs are able to exploit the channel mean and correlation information to provide a significant array gain.
, for the first time, the design of linear precoder in MIMO systems with nonzero-mean correlated channel has been addressed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal precoder is not a fixed matrix, but rather depends on channel statistics and SNR, which are time varying.
, for MIMO wireless channels with nonzero mean, the precoder can be designed to exploit the channel mean and correlation statistics at the transmitter.
the optimal precoder is a combination of a transmit beamformer matched to the channel mean and a shaping matrix matched to the transmit correlation.
